app.title: MacCheck
app.subtitle: Local Mac Inspection
app.private: Inspection data and reports stay on this Mac
sidebar.private: Runs locally · Inspection data is not uploaded
overview.title: Inspection overview
overview.intro: System information was checked automatically. Select any item for details and complete the physical tests.
overview.noAttention: No critical issue was found automatically. Complete the physical hardware tests before deciding.
base.empty: No system result is available for this section.
base.help.device: Review model, chip, memory, system and device identity.
base.help.battery: Review battery wear, cycles and current state.
base.help.security: Check organization management, Activation Lock and system security.
base.help.storage: Review disk capacity, free space and self-check status.
base.help.network: Review Wi-Fi and Bluetooth hardware and power state.
base.help.peripherals: Connected devices were read; test each physical port with an accessory.
hardware.keyboard.title: Keyboard test
hardware.keyboard.help: Test the true keyboard layout. Keys, F1–F12 and media events received by the browser light up automatically.
hardware.keyboard.step1: Press every key. Hold Fn while pressing the top row to test F1–F12.
hardware.keyboard.fnhelp: Release Fn and test brightness, Mission Control, media and volume. macOS often handles these before the page receives an event; when the system responds normally, click the matching icon below to record it.
hardware.keyboard.touchHelp: Browsers do not receive fingerprint or Touch ID press events. Use the separate Touch ID guide.
hardware.keyboard.manualRecorded: Manually recorded from the observed system response
hardware.display.title: Display test
hardware.display.help: Use the arrow keys to move through 13 fullscreen patterns at your own pace and inspect pixels, tint, bleed, lines and clarity.
hardware.display.keys: Arrow keys switch · M toggles issue · Esc exits
hardware.audio.title: Audio test
hardware.audio.help: Play the tones and record speaker and headphone results separately.
hardware.audio.speaker: Built-in speakers
hardware.audio.speakerHelp: Disconnect headphones and confirm both channels and low/mid tones.
hardware.audio.headphoneHelp: Connect wired headphones, replay, and confirm both sides.
hardware.microphone.title: Microphone test
hardware.microphone.help: Allow microphone access, record three seconds and play it back. Level movement only confirms input; you confirm quality.
hardware.microphone.denied: Microphone unavailable. Check browser permission and retry.
hardware.camera.title: Camera test
hardware.camera.help: Allow camera access and inspect clarity, stability and color. Preview stays local and is never uploaded.
hardware.camera.denied: Camera unavailable. Check browser permission and retry.
hardware.touchid.title: Touch ID test
hardware.touchid.help: A local browser cannot read the fingerprint sensor. Complete one real system verification, then record the result.
hardware.touchid.step1: Open System Settings → Touch ID & Password and confirm Touch ID settings are available.
hardware.touchid.step2: Use an enrolled finger for unlock, password autofill, or adding a fingerprint.
hardware.touchid.step3: Confirm recognition is quick and does not require repeated presses, then record the result.
hardware.touchid.boundary: Technical boundary: keyboard events exclude Touch ID, and WebAuthn success does not prove this sensor was used, so a trustworthy automatic verdict is not possible.
hardware.trackpad.title: Trackpad test
hardware.trackpad.help: Move, click all corners, single-click, double-click, secondary-click, drag, scroll and pinch. Observable actions are recorded automatically.
hardware.trackpad.area: Move throughout this area and complete each action
hardware.trackpad.forceHelp: Press firmly and feel for a second-stage haptic response; browsers cannot read pressure.
hardware.trackpad.pinchHelp: A two-finger pinch normally zooms the browser. The page prevents actual zoom after recognizing the gesture.
hardware.ports.title: Port test
hardware.ports.help: Ports are listed from the matched model. Start one test, then connect an accessory. The page detects what browsers expose and asks for confirmation only when needed.
hardware.ports.usbcHelp: Connect storage or a display and confirm a stable connection.
hardware.ports.usbaHelp: Connect USB-A storage or another known-good accessory and confirm a stable connection.
hardware.ports.thunderboltHelp: Connect a compatible Thunderbolt device or display and confirm it is recognized.
hardware.ports.hdmiHelp: Connect a display and confirm picture and audio.
hardware.ports.sdHelp: Insert a card and confirm files can be read.
hardware.ports.headphoneHelp: Connect headphones and confirm in the audio test.
hardware.ports.magsafeHelp: Connect power and confirm the indicator and charging state.
hardware.ports.ethernetHelp: Connect a working network cable and confirm that macOS establishes a wired connection.
hardware.ports.genericHelp: The complete layout cannot be established reliably for this model. Test every unlisted port with a matching accessory and record the combined result here.
hardware.ports.autoUnavailable: The browser cannot verify this port automatically; confirm the observed result
hardware.ports.notFound: No new device has been detected
hardware.ports.waiting.usb: Connect a USB or Thunderbolt device now. The page is listening for the connection.
hardware.ports.waiting.audio: Connect headphones now. The page is listening for audio-device changes.
hardware.ports.waiting.power: Connect power now. The page is listening for charging-state changes.
hardware.ports.waiting.display: Connect a display now. The page is listening for screen changes.
hardware.ports.waiting.storage: Insert the card, then select any file on it to prove that it is readable.
hardware.ports.waiting.manual: Connect a known-good accessory and confirm that it works.
hardware.ports.modelCounted: Known ports were listed for {model}; use the physical chassis for their positions.
hardware.ports.modelGeneric: The complete physical-port layout for {model} cannot be established reliably. Only confident ports are listed, with an Other physical ports item for the remainder.
hardware.ports.boundary: Automatic detection proves that the system or browser observed a new device. It does not prove bandwidth, long-term stability, or every contact pin.
issue.help: Select every issue you actually observed. The choices are saved with this inspection and included in the report.
issue.keyboard.unresponsive: One or more keys do not respond
issue.keyboard.stuck: Key sticks or does not rebound normally
issue.keyboard.media: Brightness, media or volume key problem
hardware.summary.keyboard: {standard} standard, {functions} F keys, {media} media events detected
report.title: MacCheck Inspection Report
report.disclaimer: This report combines locally readable facts with user-observed tests. It reflects the device at inspection time and is not an Apple diagnosis, warranty, or transaction guarantee.
dialog.recover: Saved progress was found for this inspection. Restore it?
dialog.skip: Skip for now? Overview and reports will mark it skipped.
message.storage: Local storage is unavailable; progress may be lost when this page closes.
message.audio: If silent, check mute, the selected output device and browser autoplay permission.
message.audioPlaying: Playing left, right and low/mid tones

device.purchase.subtitle: Automatic facts plus guided checks
device.model.title: Model year and reference age
device.model.known: Matched as a {year} model, introduced about {age} year(s) ago. This is not the unit's production date.
device.model.unknown: The database could not match an exact year. Verify the model name in About This Mac.
device.production.title: Production date
device.production.body: Modern Macs use randomized serial numbers, so production date cannot be inferred reliably. Purchase records or Apple Support records are better evidence.
device.coverage.title: Apple coverage
device.coverage.body: macOS has no stable local interface for official coverage. Open Apple's coverage page yourself and submit this serial number manually.
device.appleid.title: Apple Account sign-in
device.appleid.body: To protect account privacy, MacCheck does not read the signed-in account. Open System Settings and confirm it is signed out when required.
device.activation.title: Find My Mac / Activation Lock
device.activation.enabled: Activation Lock is reported on. The original account must turn off Find My Mac before handover, then rerun this check.
device.activation.unknown: No reliable state was returned. Verify Find My Mac is off in System Settings → Apple Account → iCloud.
